leadText: The Rival Awaits (Japanese: ライバルの存在 A Rival's Existence) is the eighth episode of A Pocketful of Adventures. It first aired in Japan on December 15, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
plainText:
The Rival Awaits (Japanese: ライバルの存在 A Rival's Existence) is the eighth episode of A Pocketful of Adventures. It first aired in Japan on December 15, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
 

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Madoka Akagi settles her differences with Midori Kudo.
Madoka completes the Pokémon Red campaign.

==Characters==
===Humans===
Madoka Akagi
Madoka's mother
Koichi Yadoya
Madoka's father
Madoka's brother
Masako
Sora Karasawa
Midori Kudo
Takeshi Iwakura
====Game characters====

===Pokémon===

==Trivia==
As part of the conclusion of the Pokémon Red storyline within the program, the credit sequence changed to Madoka putting away her Game Boy inside her belt bag.
